claim: Slagmolen is a two-Michelin-star restaurant at Molenweg 177, 3660 Opglabbeek (Oudsbergen), in an authentic watermill in the Bosbeek valley.
quote: Slagmolen — Opglabbeek — Two Stars: Excellent cooking — Molenweg 177, 3660 Opglabbeek — an authentic watermill with visible machinery inside, flanked by a stylish modern barn

claim: Slagmolen has four luxury guest rooms on-site: rooms 1 & 3 at €245 and rooms 2 & 4 (duplex) at €275, rising to €295 / €325 from 1 July; phone bookings only.
quote: Room 1 (Ground floor): €245/night. Room 2 (Duplex): €275/night. As of July 1st, our prices will be adjusted: Room 1 & 3: €295 Room 2 & 4: €325. Only be reserved by telephone: 089 85 48 88.

claim: Slagmolen is run by brothers Bert and Giel Meewis; an adjacent villa offers chic guestrooms with Scandi design touches.
quote: Adjacent villa offers chic guestrooms with Scandi design touches. The restaurant is managed by Giel and Bert Meewis.

claim: Bed and Beyond sits at Vinkenkantstraat 33, 3660 Oudsbergen (Opglabbeek) — the same village as Slagmolen — with four uniquely styled rooms run by host-designer Wendy and Tom.
quote: Vinkenkantstraat 33, 3660 Oudsbergen (Opglabbeek). Onze vier kamers zijn stuk voor stuk unieke pareltjes met een eigen look & feel. Wendy en Tom.

claim: Bed and Beyond is ranked #1 of 1 B&B/inn in Opglabbeek with a 5-of-5 Tripadvisor rating, and is run by an interior designer who treats the rooms as a showroom.
quote: Bed and Beyond is ranked #1 of 1 B&B/inn in Opglabbeek and rated 5 of 5 at Tripadvisor. The host is an interior designer and has designed the rooms kind of as a showroom.

claim: Bed and Beyond's wellness includes an indoor plunge pool, sauna and sanarium, available privately to guests.
quote: Bed and beyond - Privé sauna - Opglabbeek - indoor plunge pool, sauna and sanarium.

claim: Hostellerie Vivendum occupies an 1736 chaplain's residence in Dilsen, with 5 rooms (incl. 1 suite + 1 duplex loft) priced €180 standard / €215 suite / €245+ loft; rooms sold only paired with dinner.
quote: Een uit 1736 daterende kapelaanswoning omgetoverd tot het prachtige hotel-restaurant. Vissersstraat 2, 3650 Dilsen Stokkem. Bellevue Kamer €180; Duplex Loft €245+; De Suite €215. Rooms only available in combinatie met een diner.

claim: Hostellerie Vivendum holds one Michelin star, with a terrace listed by the guide as among Belgium's finest.
quote: Hostellerie Vivendum - Dilsen - One MICHELIN Star. The restaurant has a beautiful terrace recognized as one of Belgium's finest.

claim: ViaMichelin gives the Opglabbeek-Dilsen-Stokkem drive at roughly 5 km — a short taxi hop from Slagmolen.
quote: Opglabbeek - Dilsen-Stokkem driving directions: ~5 km.

claim: Hotel de Maretak is a six-room small hotel in Oud-Dilsen near the Maas valley with private wellness (sauna, jacuzzi, outdoor pool) and a refined restaurant exclusive to hotel guests.
quote: Small-scaled hotel in Oud-Dilsen near the Oude Maas. Six rooms with the charm of a B&B. Refined restaurant (exclusively accessible to hotel guests) and private wellness attached.

claim: Visit Limburg lists Hotel de Maretak as a cycling/walking base 15 minutes' drive from Maasmechelen Village outlet.
quote: Hotel de Maretak. Within a 15-minute drive of Maasmechelen Village Outlet and Maaseik Market Square.

claim: Landhuisjes Bij De Wouterbron sits inside a nature reserve in Opglabbeek with a seasonal outdoor swimming pond; self-catering bungalows rated 8.9 on Booking.
quote: Landhuisjes Bij De Wouterbron is set in a nature reserve in Opglabbeek and offers a secluded location, free access to a seasonal outdoor swimming pond and a restaurant. The property is rated 8.9 by recent guests.

claim: Visit Limburg lists Landhuisjes Bij De Wouterbron as official holiday-home accommodation in Opglabbeek.
quote: Holiday homes Landhuisjes Bij De Wouterbron - Visit Limburg accommodation listing.

claim: Kasteel Wurfeld in Maaseik is a castle hotel at Kapelweg 60 set in landscaped grounds with the Wintergarden restaurant and 32 atmospheric rooms.
quote: Hotel Kasteel Wurfeld, Kapelweg 60, 3680 Maaseik. Atmospheric castle bedrooms with all modern comfort.

claim: Tripadvisor scores Kasteel Wurfeld 4.1/5 over 313 reviews, ranking it #1 of 2 hotels in Maaseik, but Jan–Feb 2025 reviews flag musty odours and inconsistent food.
quote: 4.1 of 5 stars (313 reviews). #1 of 2 hotels in Maaseik. Recent reviews (January-February 2025) highlight inconsistencies including musty odors, cleanliness issues, and varying food quality.

claim: Warredal is an alternative-stay estate at Ketelstraat 77, 3680 Neeroeteren (Maaseik) with cabins, a Hobbit House and wellness lodges in woodland on the Hoge Kempen edge.
quote: Warredal — Ketelstraat 77, 3680 Neeroeteren. An original place to stay in the woods of Limburg. Cabins, a Hobbit House, and wellness lodges.

claim: Warredal advertises a Wellness Cabin in the forest with private sauna, jacuzzi and relaxation room; the estate's principle is no-wifi back-to-nature.
quote: Warredal's cosy cabins and houses are an ideal base for a romantic weekend surrounded by the nature of Hoge Kempen National Park. Wellness Cabin in the middle of the forest. The vacation park has the principle of back-to-nature; there is no wifi.

claim: Warredal cabin pricing starts at roughly €115/night; treetrunk-with-hot-tub cabins run €822 / 3 nights.
quote: Cabins start from €115 per night. Treetunk with hot tub from €822 for 3 nights.

claim: Carbon Hotel is at Europalaan 38, 3600 Genk — two minutes from Genk station — with a fifth-floor Carbon Sense City Spa (hamam, treatments) and Restaurant Gusto.
quote: Europalaan 38, 3600 Genk. Carbon Sense City Spa on the fifth floor. Restaurant Gusto. Two minute walk from the train station.

claim: Carbon Hotel is listed in the Michelin Guide as a design hotel-stay in Genk whose minimalist black palette references the city's coal-mining past.
quote: Carbon Hotel - Genk - Michelin Guide hotel. Sooty, black carbon is the prominent colour, in tribute to Genk's mining past.

claim: Hotel Stiemerheide is a 69-room English-cottage-style hotel at Wiemesmeerstraat 105, Genk, on Spiegelven golf course at the gateway of Hoge Kempen National Park.
quote: Stylish hotel built in the late 1980s in the style of an English cottage. 69 comfortable hotel rooms and suites. Wiemesmeerstraat 105, B-3600 Genk. 18th hole of Golf Club Spiegelven.

claim: Stiemerheide's restaurant Moonstone holds a Michelin Bib Gourmand under chef Koen Somers — a useful Sunday-lunch fallback.
quote: Restaurant De Kristalijn under chef Koen Somers. Restaurant Moonstone has been recognized with a Michelin Bib Gourmand.

claim: Distances from Opglabbeek city centre: Genk ~10 km, Bree ~11 km, Maaseik ~15 km, Bocholt ~16 km — all comfortably inside late-night taxi range.
quote: From Opglabbeek to Bocholt 16 km, Genk ~10.5 km, Bree ~11 km, Maaseik ~15 km.
